the development of novel gene therapy approaches for the control of hypertension.
the development of a novel approach for the treatment of hypertension based on gene transfer of angiotensine type 1 receptor (AT1) receptor antisense (AS).

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of a single gene-transfer strategy can successfully control hypertension on a permanent and chronic basis.
a single injection in the neonatal period with a gene-transfer vector expressing AT1R-antisense is sufficient to control hypertension for the rest of life.
the LNSV vector containing AT1R antisense RNA was able to lower blood pressure in the SH rat.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the renin-angitensin system is a good target for the treatment of hypertension.
